fixes.title: financial_p1-p4 all 1800s timeout
fixes.summary: Root cause was NOT P0-RAA-1 (RAA inferred incorrectly). Real cause: data-pipeline/src/pipeline/scheduler_jobs.py used get_conn().getconn() — double contextmanager misuse that silently failed on every cron job entry/exit. Fixed all 3 sites (initialize, _ensure_entry, _mark_finished) to use 'with get_conn() as conn:' correctly. Also migrated scheduler_jobs table schema: added missing columns (started_at, finished_at, status, record) via ALTER TABLE; dropped NOT NULL on job_type. Verified: financial.fetch_financial_report() works for sample stocks (5/5 in 1.5s total). Full batch=1 (~1380 stocks) takes ~16min, within timeout.

scheduler_jobs_entry_exit_succeed.result: rows can be inserted/updated via track_job decorator
